A '''Spell of Comfort''' was a [[Dathomir Magic|spell]] that could be cast by the [[Witches of Dathomir]]. It allowed an injured witch to act as if she was not injured. It could also be used to take away another's pain, though doing so required physical contact.<ref name="CTD" />
